issues.description: Method name for feeding all animals is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and solution specify feedAllAnimals(), but the template Main.java sample code calls farm.feed(). This naming mismatch can confuse students about which method to implement and use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Update the template Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), or alternatively change the problem statement and solution to use feed() if that name is preferred. Ensure the Farm class in the template declares the same method name as the specification (feedAllAnimals()).

issues.description: The template Main calls farm.feed() while the problem specification and the solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(). This is a naming mismatch for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals). Students following the template's Main may look for or implement a feed() method that is not defined in the specification/solution, causing confusion and potential compile/runtime errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template use the same method name as the problem and solution. Replace the call to farm.feed() in template Main with farm.feedAllAnimals(), and ensure the Farm template declares/implements feedAllAnimals(). Alternatively, provide a feed() wrapper in Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals() and document the alias, but aligning to feedAllAnimals() is preferred.
